subject: Sponsor co-fund ledger and credit interop inquiry
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Elena Russo <elena.russo@venturex.com>, billing@venturex.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Sponsor co-fund ledger and credit interop inquiry

Hi Elena / VentureX billing team,

Thanks again for partnering on the SeedSpring cohort — excited to get the kickoff rolling. Quick billing question as we finalize the sponsor funding flow:

1) How do you want co-funded credits to appear on our side and on your invoice? Specifically — will VentureX issue credits that become a negative line item on the invoice (aggregated at the invoice level), or do you need us to reflect the sponsor as a separate credit token / coupon so you can reconcile at the sponsor cost-center level?

2) For accounting purposes our finance team needs a sample invoice that shows: (a) usage charges, (b) Redwood promotional allowance, and (c) sponsor-funded credit application. Do you have an example we can use so we can confirm GL mapping and tax treatment?

3) If VentureX intends to co-fund only a portion of a team’s monthly consumption (e.g., $5k of a $12k month), can those sponsor credits be applied pro-rata per-team within the same invoice, or do you prefer an external credit note / PO that offsets the sponsor share?

I attached a short credit-mapping template to show how our billing team would prefer to map line items. Can you confirm whether VentureX needs a PO number, sponsor identifier, or specific invoice description to reconcile on your end?

If easier, happy to jump on a 20-minute call with billing and finance to align — can do tomorrow afternoon PST.

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, GTM Partnerships | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: credit-mapping-template.xlsx (Excel, 22KB)]

From: Elena Russo <elena.russo@venturex.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: billing@venturex.com, Samir Patel <samir@seedhub.co>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 11:01:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Sponsor co-fund ledger and credit interop inquiry

Hi Marcus — thanks for the clear note and congrats on the cohort launch.

Short answers up front: we typically issue sponsor funding as a negative line item on the invoice tied to a sponsor identifier (VX-SPONSOR-21 in this program). That ends up reducing the net amount due rather than creating a separate payable/credit note. We do that because our procurement prefers one payable per month for each cohort.

However — we are flexible if Redwood needs a separate accounting line. Two items to flag from our side:

- We need a clear description on the invoice referencing the sponsor and the cohort name for internal allocation (i.e., “SeedSpring cohort — sponsor credit (VX-SPONSOR-21)”).
- For tax/expense attribution we usually require the sponsor name and a PO number. We can produce a PO referencing VX-SPONSOR-21 if you can accept the credit as an invoice-level offset.

I attached our sponsorship policy and an example invoice from a previous cohort. Take a look and let me know if that format will work for Redwood’s GL mapping. If not, we can ask billing to issue a separate credit note and provide a sponsor-facing invoice.

Happy to join a quick sync with your finance team — Samir from SeedHub is cc’d and can help facilitate timing.

Best,
Elena Russo
Head of Partnerships, VentureX Labs
[Attachment: sponsorship-policy.pdf (PDF, 78KB)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Elena Russo <elena.russo@venturex.com>, billing@venturex.com
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 13:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sponsor co-fund ledger and credit interop inquiry

Elena — really helpful, thanks. Looping in Kimberly from Finance. A couple of clarifying points from Redwood’s side:

- Our promo credit mechanism can apply credits as either (A) an invoice-level allowance (the usual flow) or (B) as per-customer credit tokens that are tracked on a per-account basis. Option B makes it easier for us to show a sponsor-specific line in our own AR aging and to pass-through sponsor identifiers.

- If VentureX issues a PO, Finance would prefer that PO be included in the invoice description so the sponsor funding maps directly to the PO number in our ledger. We can also accept a separate credit note if that’s the only viable path on VentureX’s procurement side.

- Tax treatment: can VentureX confirm whether sponsor-funded credits are considered a purchase reduction (i.e., reduce our taxable revenue) or a third-party subsidy? That affects how our accounting books reflect the revenue and any VAT treatment.

Attached is an example invoice with our suggested description and the HubSpot deal link for context. If VentureX prefers the single-invoice negative-line approach, we can map the sponsor cost-center to a custom GL code so your finance team receives a matching description.

Kimberly — can you advise on acceptable PO formatting and whether Redwood needs any additional sponsor legal language on the invoice?

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Head of Launch Programs, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: example-invoice-redwood.pdf (PDF, 54KB)]

From: VentureX Billing <billing@venturex.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Elena Russo <elena.russo@venturex.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 15:43:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Sponsor co-fund ledger and credit interop inquiry

Hi Ben / Marcus — this is Billing at VentureX. We can accommodate either approach but prefer the sponsor to show as a distinct description on the invoice so internal chargebacks are straightforward. Action items from our side:

1) We will issue a PO number for the cohort sponsor funding (PO: VX-PO-3321). Please include that PO on the invoice line that contains the sponsor credit description.

2) We will provide a sponsor identifier (VX-SPONSOR-21) that should also be included in the ledger description.

3) For tax: our tax team treats sponsor-funded credits as an expense reduction that reduces the net payable amount; we will provide a short confirmation letter if Redwood needs it for tax reporting.

Next steps: Marcus / Ben — can you share the desired invoice description and the GL code Redwood would like us to reference? Once we have the PO and exact description we will confirm on our side and push the PO to you.

Best,
VentureX Billing Team
billing@venturex.com
